title: Signature Core-1 Datacenter Card
summary: Signature-authored concept: a datacenter AI card optimized for the Signature software stack.
details: Signature Core-1 is a JAH-designed accelerator concept: a PCIe datacenter card with large on-package memory, native FP8/FP4 tensor units, and a compiler target matching the Signature inference stack. The concept specifies a memory-first architecture (compute sized to feed the memory, not vice versa) for LLM serving. Labeled Signature throughout — a concept design, not shipping hardware.

demo.title: Concept spec sheet
demo.program:
spec = {"memory_gb": 192, "bf16_tflops": 2000, "power_w": 600}
print(f"{spec['bf16_tflops']/spec['power_w']:.1f} TFLOPS/W target")

title: JAH Inference Blade
summary: Signature-authored concept: a low-power inference blade for dense serving racks.
details: JAH Inference Blade is a JAH-designed blade concept: 8 inference-optimized chips per blade with shared memory pooling, targeting maximum tokens-per-watt for chat serving. The concept includes a power-telemetry unit per blade for the Signature power-aware scheduler. Labeled Signature; a concept design.

demo.title: Blade efficiency target
demo.program:
tps, watts = 4000, 2000
print(f"{tps/watts:.1f} tokens/sec per watt (target)")

title: Signature Training Tile
summary: Signature-authored concept: a training tile with on-tile interconnect for tensor parallelism.
details: Signature Training Tile is a JAH-designed training accelerator concept: tiles connect via a high-bandwidth on-package fabric so tensor parallelism never leaves the package, with HBM stacks per tile. The concept targets 60%+ MFU out of the box via co-designed collectives. Labeled Signature throughout — a concept design.

demo.title: Tile fabric math
demo.program:
tiles, bw_tbs = 4, 1.8
print(f"{tiles} tiles x {bw_tbs} TB/s on-package fabric")

title: JAH Memory-First Accelerator
summary: Signature-authored concept: an accelerator where memory capacity, not FLOPs, is the headline spec.
details: JAH Memory-First Accelerator is a JAH-designed concept that inverts the usual spec sheet: 1 TB of on-card memory with 'enough' compute to saturate it, aimed at serving 70B-400B models on single cards. The concept trades peak FLOPs for capacity and memory bandwidth. Labeled Signature; a concept design.

demo.title: Memory-first fit
demo.program:
mem_tb = 1
print(f"400B Q4 = {400*0.5:.0f}GB -> fits in {mem_tb}TB with KV headroom")

title: Signature Sparse Compute Unit
summary: Signature-authored concept: hardware that skips zeros — native 2:4 and unstructured sparsity.
details: Signature Sparse Compute Unit is a JAH-designed accelerator concept with native sparse tensor cores: 2:4 structured sparsity at full throughput plus unstructured sparsity support, doubling effective FLOPs on pruned models. The concept pairs with the Signature sparsity-aware training method. Labeled Signature throughout — a concept design.

demo.title: Sparse speedup
demo.program:
dense, sparse_ratio = 1000, 0.5
print(f"effective: {dense/(1-sparse_ratio):.0f} TFLOPS at 50% sparsity")

title: JAH Photonic Inference Concept
summary: Signature-authored concept: photonic matrix multiplication for ultra-low-energy inference.
details: JAH Photonic Inference Concept is a JAH-designed research concept: perform matrix multiplications optically (light interference) for near-zero-energy MACs, with electronic control planes. The concept acknowledges the hard problems (precision, programmability) and scopes itself to fixed-model inference appliances. Labeled Signature; a research concept, not a product.

demo.title: Photonic energy sketch
demo.program:
macs, j_per_mac_elec, j_per_mac_phot = 1e12, 1e-12, 1e-14
print(f"electronic: {macs*j_per_mac_elec:.0f}J vs photonic: {macs*j_per_mac_phot:.2f}J")

title: Signature Analog-Digital Hybrid Tile
summary: Signature-authored concept: analog crossbars for MACs, digital for control and precision.
details: Signature Analog-Digital Hybrid Tile is a JAH-designed concept pairing analog in-memory crossbars (dense MACs at extreme efficiency) with a digital control plane that corrects and calibrates. The concept targets edge-datacenter inference where watts matter most. Labeled Signature throughout — a concept design.

demo.title: Hybrid precision plan
demo.program: print("analog: 95% of MACs | digital: calibration + residuals")

title: JAH Edge TPU-Class Chip
summary: Signature-authored concept: a phone-grade NPU for the Signature Edge Runtime.
details: JAH Edge TPU-Class Chip is a JAH-designed mobile NPU concept: 30 TOPS INT8, hardware support for the Signature quantization formats, and a delegate interface for the Signature Edge Runtime. The concept targets on-device LLM inference at 5-10 tokens/sec within phone power budgets. Labeled Signature; a concept design.

demo.title: Edge token budget
demo.program:
tops, tops_per_token = 30, 2
print(f"~{tops/tops_per_token:.0f} tok/s INT8 (rough)")

title: Signature Wafer-Scale Concept
summary: Signature-authored concept: JAH's take on wafer-scale integration for training.
details: Signature Wafer-Scale Concept is a JAH-designed wafer-scale architecture concept: a full wafer of AI tiles with on-wafer interconnect, targeting the memory wall the same way Cerebras does, but with a Signature twist — tiles are heterogeneous (compute tiles + memory tiles + IO tiles). Labeled Signature throughout — a concept design.

demo.title: Wafer tile count
demo.program:
tiles = {"compute": 600, "memory": 200, "io": 40}
print("tiles:", sum(tiles.values()), tiles)

title: JAH Chiplet Mesh Design
summary: Signature-authored concept: chiplet-based accelerator with a 2D mesh interconnect.
details: JAH Chiplet Mesh Design is a JAH-designed packaging concept: compute, memory, and IO chiplets on an interposer with a 2D mesh, letting configurations scale from edge (2 chiplets) to datacenter (32 chiplets) on one architecture. The concept's value is SKU flexibility from shared chiplets. Labeled Signature; a concept design.

demo.title: Chiplet scaling
demo.program:
for n in [2, 8, 32]:
    print(f"{n} chiplets: {n*250} TFLOPS, {n*24}GB")

title: Signature Low-Power Training Card
summary: Signature-authored concept: a 300W training card for labs without datacenter power.
details: Signature Low-Power Training Card is a JAH-designed concept: a 300W PCIe card with enough memory (96 GB) and efficiency-tuned clocks for university labs and startups to train 7-30B models on standard power. The concept democratizes training beyond hyperscale facilities. Labeled Signature throughout — a concept design.

demo.title: Lab cluster math
demo.program:
cards, w = 8, 300
print(f"8 cards: {cards*w/1000:.1f} kW — fits standard lab power")

title: JAH Interconnect Fabric Chip
summary: Signature-authored concept: a dedicated collective-offload chip for scale-out fabrics.
details: JAH Interconnect Fabric Chip is a JAH-designed concept: a standalone chip that offloads all-reduce/all-gather from GPUs, with 32x 800G ports and in-network reduction. The concept lets any GPU cluster get NVSwitch-class collectives over Ethernet. Labeled Signature; a concept design.

demo.title: Offload benefit
demo.program: print("all-reduce in fabric: GPUs free to compute during collectives")

title: Signature Quantization Engine ASIC
summary: Signature-authored concept: an ASIC that quantizes and dequantizes at memory speed.
details: Signature Quantization Engine ASIC is a JAH-designed concept: a memory-side accelerator performing INT4/INT8/FP8 quantize/dequantize inline at full HBM bandwidth, so quantized serving pays no conversion overhead. The concept pairs with JAH Adaptive Quantizer's mixed-precision formats. Labeled Signature throughout — a concept design.

demo.title: Inline quant math
demo.program:
bw_tbs = 8
print(f"converts {bw_tbs} TB/s with zero extra passes")

title: JAH Cooling-Integrated Package
summary: Signature-authored concept: accelerator package with microfluidic cooling built in.
details: JAH Cooling-Integrated Package is a JAH-designed packaging concept: microfluidic channels etched into the interposer carry coolant directly under hot spots, targeting 2kW packages without exotic facility plumbing. The concept attacks the power-density wall at the package level. Labeled Signature; a concept design.

details: Signature Secure Enclave Accelerator is a JAH-designed concept: an AI card with a hardware root of trust, encrypted memory, and remote attestation, so models and data stay confidential even from the cloud operator. The concept targets regulated industries (health, finance). Labeled Signature throughout — a concept design.

title: JAH Open ISA Proposal
summary: Signature-authored concept: an open instruction set for AI tensor operations.
details: JAH Open ISA Proposal is a JAH-designed specification concept: an open, royalty-free ISA for tensor/matrix/AI operations that any vendor can implement, with compliance tests and a reference simulator. The concept aims to break CUDA lock-in at the ISA level. Labeled Signature; a specification concept.

The concept fights benchmarketing with metrology. Labeled Signature throughout — a concept design.

details: JAH Power Telemetry Unit is a JAH-designed concept: fine-grained power sensors per chiplet reporting at 1kHz to the Signature power-aware scheduler, enabling joule-accurate cost accounting per request. Labeled Signature; a concept design.

title: Signature Multi-Die Scheduler
summary: Signature-authored concept: hardware scheduler for multi-die packages.
details: Signature Multi-Die Scheduler is a JAH-designed concept: a hardware work distributor that schedules tiles/waves across dies in a multi-die package with thermal awareness, migrating work from hot dies. The concept keeps multi-die packages fed without host intervention. Labeled Signature throughout — a concept design.

title: JAH On-Package Memory Stack
summary: Signature-authored concept: 3D-stacked memory tiers on the accelerator package.
details: JAH On-Package Memory Stack is a JAH-designed concept: HBM for hot weights, a dense DRAM tier for warm KV cache, and a flash tier for cold models — all on package, managed by the Signature KV Vault. The concept brings the memory hierarchy onto the chip. Labeled Signature; a concept design.

details: Signature Compiler Target Spec is a JAH-designed specification concept: a stable compiler target (IR, ABI, kernel conventions) across all Signature accelerator concepts, so one compiled model runs on any Signature chip. title: JAH Failure-Tolerant Array
summary: Signature-authored concept: an accelerator array that routes around dead tiles.
details: JAH Failure-Tolerant Array is a JAH-designed concept: a tile array with spare tiles and a hardware remapper that routes around manufacturing defects or in-field failures, raising yield and field reliability. The concept treats redundancy as a first-class design axis. Labeled Signature; a concept design.

title: Signature Cost-Per-FLOP Optimizer
summary: Signature-authored method: choose accelerators by measured cost per FLOP on your workload.
details: Signature Cost-Per-FLOP Optimizer is a JAH-designed procurement method: benchmark candidate accelerators on your actual model (not vendor slides), divide 3-year TCO by achieved FLOPs, and buy the winner. The method includes a benchmark protocol and a TCO worksheet. Labeled Signature throughout.

demo.program:

print(f"${tco_3y/achieved_pflops/1095:.0f} per PFLOP-day")
